blocks.title: Mezze for the whole table
blocks.p: Eight small dishes, cold and hot, arrive together; everyone helps themselves and passes the bread. Hummus, moutabal, tabbouleh, fatayer, falafel: that's how a Lebanese meal begins, and often how it ends.

blocks.title: A red room and a warm welcome
blocks.p: Pomegranate-red walls, white tablecloths, pale banquettes and Lebanon in pictures on the walls. You're welcomed like family, whether you come as two, with the kids or with colleagues.

blocks.title: Marc's mezze, at your place
blocks.p: For a birthday, a leaving do or an office lunch, Marc prepares mezze platters and assortments of Lebanese pastries. Tell us the date and how many guests.

story.title: From the mountains of Lebanon to rue des Volontaires
p: Marc was born in a village high in the Lebanese mountains. He grew up with a whole food culture handed down by his parents, and decided, in turn, to share it.
That's how he came to rue des Volontaires, in the heart of the 15th arrondissement. Everything you taste here is homemade.
He wishes you a good meal, and hopes that for a couple of hours you'll travel back with him to the scents and flavours of his childhood.

items.a: It's best in the evening and at weekends, as the room fills up quickly. On weekday lunchtimes you'll often find a table without booking. Book online or on +33 1 43 06 82 96.
Just ask us when you book and we'll tell you for each dish. The beef comes from Europe. The restaurant also serves Lebanese wines and arak.

items.q: Are there vegetarian and vegan dishes?
items.a: Plenty. Many of the mezze are vegetarian (hummus, moutabal, tabbouleh, falafel, fatayer, vine leaves, foul…) and there's a full vegetarian mezze at €24. Several are also free of animal products: ask us which.
Yes: birthdays, team meals, family parties. For more than 12 people, send us a group request so we can prepare the room and the menu.
Call us on +33 1 43 06 82 96 and we'll tell you what you can take away and when to come by. For a party or an office lunch, ask about our mezze and pastry platters.

items.q: Which payment methods do you accept?
items.a: Ask us when you book and we'll let you know.
Yes, the Bambino menu at €13.90 for under-10s: a skewer, orange-blossom yoghurt and a drink.

traiteur.intro: Marc's mezze and pastries for your parties, meetings and office lunches.

p: Hummus, moutabal, tabbouleh, vine leaves, falafel, fatayer, samboussik: mezze are made for buffets. Marc puts the platters together around your guest count and tastes, with vegetarian options.
Pistachio baklava, honey namoura, bourma, orange-blossom mouhalabieh: a pastry assortment always goes down well at the end of a meal or for an afternoon treat.
Send us the date, the number of people and what you'd like. Marc replies with a proposal and a price. Collection is at the restaurant, 12 rue des Volontaires; for delivery, let's talk.

paris15.metaDescription: Chez Marc, a Lebanese restaurant in the 15th arrondissement, 12 rue des Volontaires, between Volontaires and Pasteur: homemade mezze, grills, pastries. 4.6/5 on Google.
paris15.intro: Between Volontaires and Pasteur metro stations, a Lebanese address where everything is homemade.

p: At Chez Marc, the hummus, tabbouleh, moutabal, vine leaves and pastries are made on site. The menu follows the classics of the Lebanese table: cold and hot mezze, plancha grills, shawarma, kibbeh.
On weekday lunchtimes, the €16.90 menu brings together a grill, three mezze and a dessert or coffee. In the evening, the €26.90 menu or a full mezze to take your time.
The restaurant is at 12 rue des Volontaires, two minutes from Volontaires metro (line 12) and a few minutes from Pasteur (lines 6 and 12), near rue de Vaugirard.
